source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 727 helper asserts missing timers, stopped meteors, hidden determinate progress, zero start requests and no active processes before clearing broken state. Current clearStatusBar retains this diagnostic-before-repair pattern and uses FeedbackService stop-meteors. promiseServerIdle delegates to that shared helper after protocol idle. Preserve failed assertions while repairing leaked state so a cleanup fallback does not silently turn a test failure into success.
title: Report leaked status-bar state before repairing test cleanup
